Vardiff Algorithm Benchmark — Wall Time

4 algorithms (classic, pid, qpid, champion) × 26 scenarios, run at real time (--speed 1) so handshake / TCP / idle-backstop / champion-tick latencies are represented faithfully. Setpoint = 4 shares/min. Regenerate with benchmark/run-benchmark.sh then this tool.

runs: 104failures/timeouts: 0setpoint: 4 spm

Convergence after hashrate-step events

“never converged” = a step knocked the miner's target out of the ±20% band and it did not return before run end (≥180s observed) — the controller under-reacts to that direction. Up = miner sped up (pool must raise difficulty); down = miner slowed.
